SANPAR was officially established on February 7, 1994, marking the beginning of its journey in industrial air and thermal engineering.
The company’s first office was inaugurated on February 22, 1994, laying the foundation for its operations.
In March 1994, SANPAR participated in its first industrial exhibition and successfully received its first purchase order, initiating its businessoperations.
Later that year, SANPAR sold its first compressed air dryer, branded as ECODRAIR, demonstrating its product innovation capabilities.
SANPAR also supplied a 2000 mm diameter air filter to GTRE / DRDO, indicating its early contribution to the Indian defence sector.
In 1995, SANPAR obtained its industrial license for manufacturing, formalizing its position as a certified manufacturer in the industry.
By 1996, the company achieved a significant milestone by delivering its first air chiller for a defence application, marking the beginning of its longstanding association with defence technology.
In 1997, SANPAR expanded its operational structure by forming its sister concern, known as SANPAR Industries Pvt. Ltd.
In 1998, SANPAR developed and successfully sold its first XEROS compressed air dryer, introducing a new product line to its portfolio.
During 1999, SANPAR shifted its operations to Whitefield, where it developed pressure die-casting dies for use in filters and drain assemblies.
That same year, SANPAR also secured trademark registration for its ECODRAIR brand, establishing its intellectual property rights.

The year 2000 witnessed multiple technological innovations including the supply of SANPAR’s first air chiller to LRDE / DRDO, the development of its first industrial dehumidifier, and the introduction of compact brazed aluminum heat exchangers for use in XEROS dryers.
SANPAR also developed its first precision air conditioner during this time, further diversifying its product offerings.
In 2004, SANPAR delivered its first oil chiller integrated with a water chiller, showing advancement in combination cooling systems.
That same year, SANPAR executed its first export order to Nageri Sembian in Malaysia, marking the start of its international business footprint.
SANPAR purchased industrial property in Bommasandra in 2006, paving the way for its future expansion.
By 2009, the company had shifted its operations to its own facility at the Bommasandra Industrial Estate, creating a stronger infrastructure foundation.
In the same year, SANPAR received ISO 9001:2015 certification, reaffirming its commitment to international quality standards.
In 2010, SANPAR introduced its PLC-based XEROS air dryers, integrating programmable control technology for enhanced performance.
That year, the company also executed a liquid cooling system for ground testing applications, showcasing its innovation in engineered thermal systems.
In 2015, SANPAR participated in the HANNOVER MESSE exhibition in Germany, one of the world’s most prestigious industrial trade fairs, marking its global visibility.
That year, SANPAR also executed its first airborne cooling system specifically designed for airborne radar applications.
In 2016, SANPAR’s airborne Liquid Cooling System (LCS) was fully qualified and approved by DGAQA and CEMILAC, solidifying the company’s presence in aerospace and defence sectors.
In 2017, SANPAR achieved certification for the Aerospace Standard EN 9100:2018 (AS 9100 D) and supplied its first airborne liquid circulation module.
In 2019, SANPAR further advanced its capabilities by supplying an airborne aluminum piping system equipped with integrated sensors, enhancing its product performance in critical applications.
In 2020, the company continued its strong association with the defence sector by supplying air chillers for LRU (Line Replaceable Unit) cooling and water chillers to CHESS / DRDO.

In 2024, SANPAR strategically bifurcated into two specialized entities: SANPAR Industries Pvt. Ltd. and SANPAR Defence Systems Pvt. Ltd., enabling a focused approach toward both industrial and defence markets.

In 2025, SANPAR developed a diesel-cum-grid powered ACM-based air conditioning trolley for use in defence applications, showcasing its continued leadership in engineering customized and mission-critical cooling systems.

headings.text: Driven by Purpose. Guided by Vision.
SANPAR is a family of a collective goal. And as believed, our employees are our biggest competitive advantage.
Engineering with Purpose. Innovating for the Planet.
The Principles That Power Our Purpose
Committed to Global Standards of Quality & Compliance

paragraphs: Sanpar
Established in 1994, SANPAR has over three decades of experience in application, manufacturing, engineering and R&D in the field of airing solution.
We have proved ourself strong in each step in the chain of technology, Design, Development, Manufacturing and Delivery.
Our Manufacturing facility is located in Banglore, India is manned by our team of qualified, skilled employees who work seamlessly to produce world class products.
From inventions to innovations, energy responsibility to environment stewardship, SANPAR provides airing solutions to complex thermal engineering applications.
we have constantly challenged the norms and consistently pushed the boundaries to deliver solutions that earned us a reputation of trust and quality.

SANPAR vests its energy to deliver innovative solutions for the treatment of compressed air. Every assignment helps leverage our expertise while helping us implement turnkey projects with customized precision. The valuable experience earned through varying projects makes us industry ready when it comes to customization and special requirement commissioning.

The technical innovation in the design and manufacture of Compressed Air Treatment Systems, Industrial Cooling System and Advanced Cooling Systems have changed the industry perception, armed with impeccable product quality, and customer support has helped us claim a commendable position when conservation of energy and environment is paramount. The different clientele requires special attention, our service and application-based marketing network spread across the globe ensure just that when it comes to providing solution that not only deliver but also ensure an enduring and profitable relationship.

Delivering innovative, cost-effective, and reliable thermal engineering products to the manufacturing fraternity even to aerospace by empowering the people at work to demonstrate their skillsets at the global level.
To design and manufacture zero defect products to create long lasting trust within clientele.

Airing solutions to where heat is a menace – to make reliable and energy efficient utility cooling products to serve the manufacturing fraternity thereby creating extraordinary leadership in the realm of Thermal engineering related to industries and aerospace.

SANPAR is committed to design, manufacture and maintain its products to the satisfaction of the customer through continual improvement in the quality management system. Our quality management system is an epitome of inter-related activities of the processes that will direct and control the organization in order to continually improve the effectiveness and efficacy. We have established company goals mapped with individual department quality objectives set out with a quality policy and strategy. We identify the customer requirements and their satisfaction at every transaction interface.

Heart and Mind recklessly fall in love and the result is what has come to be known as SANPAR. The passion to deliver some of the most revered and ground breaking solutions in Compressed Air Treatment have been our founding objective. The result is the trust and partnership garnered with some of the most successful manufacturers and service companies that are global brand and household names.

SANPAR, is at the threshold of a booming manufacturing market; primarily with the industries competing globally to deliver end products that are competent and cost effective. SANPAR is making the most of this opportunity with an efficient and committed team of engineers delivering customized solutions that not only exceed expectations but set a whole new standard in compressed air treatment while conserving energy and saving precious resources. As customization is the key to help our clients produce end products that are perfect and competent, the dedicated R&D team at SANPAR, ensures that delivery of outstanding solution that are result oriented and time bound. Our courtship with engineering technology and the constant urge to outdo ourselves in Compressed Air Treatment keeps us ticking and we like it like this.
Chairman & Managing Director

At SANPAR, sustainability is more than a commitment — it’s a core responsibility. In the realm of compressed air and cooling systems, where energy usage is significant, our goal is to reduce environmental impact without compromising performance.
We design and deliver energy-efficient airing solutions that minimize power consumption, reduce greenhouse gas emissions, and optimize system performance across industries.
Energy-Efficient Designsthat lower operational costs and carbon footprints
Smart Control Technologyfor optimized performance and reduced wastage
Eco-Friendly Refrigerantsin our chillers and dryers
Long-Lasting Productsthat reduce replacement cycles and material waste
We design and deliver energy-efficient airing solutions that minimize power consumption, reduce greenhouse gas emissions, and optimize system performance across industries.
We act with integrity, fairness, and responsibilityin everything we do.
We believe collaboration leads to greater innovation and stronger results.
We continuously learn, iterate, adapt, and create smarter solutions.
We attract, develop, and retain top talent committed to excellence.
We honor every individual—employees, clients, and partners alike.
We go beyond satisfaction, delivering reliable solutions that exceed expectations.
We ensure a safe work environment through proactive responsibility and care.

Our highly experienced workforce has several qualified engineers on-hand to address specific enquiries. Our research started in Water Treatment solutions and our expertise has grown to include comprehensive knowledge and exposure to Industrial Utilities such as Air, Steam & Water. SANPAR management has had immeasurable success in our organizational mission. We continue to focus on our primary aim and subsequent success in establishing SANPAR as a leader in providing the Indian Industry and specifically the high growth manufacturing segment with energy efficient air treatment products.
Each functional department has an individual Departmental Head with equal growth opportunities.

SANPAR takes immense pride and dedicated time towards projects to provide the solution deemed a perfect fit. Understanding, documenting and tailoring the right solution addressing key challenges under limited resources keeps our team on toes. As for our trusted partners in business channels, we ensure to maintain price protection and supply priority post commitments.

Dedicated to maintaining global excellence by following stringent quality practices, ensuring reliable performance, regulatory compliance, and continual improvement across all operations to meet industry and customer expectations.
International standard for quality management systems focused on consistent product and service quality.

By 1996, the company achieved a significant milestone by delivering its first air chiller for a defence application, marking the beginning of its longstanding association with defence technology.
In 1997, SANPAR expanded its operational structure by forming its sister concern, known as SANPAR Industries Pvt. Ltd.
In 1998, SANPAR developed and successfully sold its first XEROS compressed air dryer, introducing a new product line to its portfolio.
During 1999, SANPAR shifted its operations to Whitefield, where it developed pressure die-casting dies for use in filters and drain assemblies.
That same year, SANPAR also secured trademark registration for its ECODRAIR brand, establishing its intellectual property rights.

The year 2000 witnessed multiple technological innovations including the supply of SANPAR’s first air chiller to LRDE / DRDO, the development of its first industrial dehumidifier, and the introduction of compact brazed aluminum heat exchangers for use in XEROS dryers.
SANPAR also developed its first precision air conditioner during this time, further diversifying its product offerings.
In 2004, SANPAR delivered its first oil chiller integrated with a water chiller, showing advancement in combination cooling systems.
That same year, SANPAR executed its first export order to Nageri Sembian in Malaysia, marking the start of its international business footprint.
SANPAR purchased industrial property in Bommasandra in 2006, paving the way for its future expansion.
By 2009, the company had shifted its operations to its own facility at the Bommasandra Industrial Estate, creating a stronger infrastructure foundation.
In the same year, SANPAR received ISO 9001:2015 certification, reaffirming its commitment to international quality standards.
In 2010, SANPAR introduced its PLC-based XEROS air dryers, integrating programmable control technology for enhanced performance.
That year, the company also executed a liquid cooling system for ground testing applications, showcasing its innovation in engineered thermal systems.
In 2015, SANPAR participated in the HANNOVER MESSE exhibition in Germany, one of the world’s most prestigious industrial trade fairs, marking its global visibility.
That year, SANPAR also executed its first airborne cooling system specifically designed for airborne radar applications.
In 2016, SANPAR’s airborne Liquid Cooling System (LCS) was fully qualified and approved by DGAQA and CEMILAC, solidifying the company’s presence in aerospace and defence sectors.
In 2017, SANPAR achieved certification for the Aerospace Standard EN 9100:2018 (AS 9100 D) and supplied its first airborne liquid circulation module.
In 2019, SANPAR further advanced its capabilities by supplying an airborne aluminum piping system equipped with integrated sensors, enhancing its product performance in critical applications.
In 2020, the company continued its strong association with the defence sector by supplying air chillers for LRU (Line Replaceable Unit) cooling and water chillers to CHESS / DRDO.

In 2024, SANPAR strategically bifurcated into two specialized entities: SANPAR Industries Pvt. Ltd. and SANPAR Defence Systems Pvt. Ltd., enabling a focused approach toward both industrial and defence markets.

In 2025, SANPAR developed a diesel-cum-grid powered ACM-based air conditioning trolley for use in defence applications, showcasing its continued leadership in engineering customized and mission-critical cooling systems.

support-service.title: Support & Services - Sanpar
support-service.meta_description: Support & Services Aftercare Excellence Ongoing Assurance Providing cutting-edge solutions covers only half of our implementation cycle. We take pride on our functional expertise in the other important aspect of a logical, customer-experience: the maintenance and regular monitoring of our installed products. To our customer base, thank you for the continued trust and reliance
paragraphs: Sanpar

Providing cutting-edge solutions covers only half of our implementation cycle. We take pride on our functional expertise in the other important aspect of a logical, customer-experience: the maintenance and regular monitoring of our installed products.

To our customer base, thank you for the continued trust and reliance over the credibility of our solution catering towards the health of your capital equipment. After all, we understand that our product adds value to the quality of output of your equipment.

Beyond the one-year warranty on our product and spares, we offer a lifetime support maintenance program towards our ecosystem. This is primarily to ensure timely replacement of elements and spares provides maximum availability of your equipment at minimal operating costs - contributing to value as projected.

Our service network is constantly upgraded so in the case of any eventuality, response times can be minimized to keep your production schedules on time. Each of faults are logged in our internal complaint tracker and we have constantly used our data logs to further enhance the operational efficiency and lifespan of our products.

We offer regular maintenance checks, which help in identifying problems early and preventing costly down times. Service engineers will periodically check your systems and optimize them for energy efficiency.

The equipment is handed over to the customer once the product is successfully commissioned. SANPAR believes that the commissioning is complete only when the end user is proficient in the maintenance of the equipment.

Service agreements are available at the time of equipment purchase to provide priority scheduling and cost control by our trained engineers. A service warranty is maintained with service reports to keep track of individual system lifeline. Envisaging an upcoming problem by qualified team ensures minimal downtime.

As a standard, SANPAR offers an Annual Service Contract (ASC) with a Service Engineer visiting the customer’s site bi-monthly / quarterly during a contract year. Fixed service prices can avoid any economical or financial surprises. A total responsibility plan is an ultimate risk coverage with being eligible for upgrades and original spare replacements.

For trouble free operation of the system, a stock of certain spares has to be maintained. Most of the spares will be dispatched within 48 hours, however some spares will be dispatched subject to their availability with our suppliers. Acquiring original, certified and compliant spares can maintain the lifetime of the equipment and overall system efficiency in output. Only genuine parts can guarantee the performance and integrity of the capital equipment.

The training given by SANPAR to all its service engineers, coupled with their comprehensive knowledge on Compressed Air Technology and Refrigeration Concepts, results in excellent trouble shooting capability by our service team. In our experience, most issues are solved by giving tips to the customer via the telephone, once again reinforcing our belief in our products and solutions. We also cater to top priority emergency response to SOS calls for assistance by our nearest service centre.

Support & Services
Aftercare Excellence
Ongoing Assurance
Providing cutting-edge solutions covers only half of our implementation cycle. We take pride on our functional expertise in the other important aspect of a logical, customer-experience: the maintenance and regular monitoring of our installed products.
To our customer base, thank you for the continued trust and reliance over the credibility of our solution catering towards the health of your capital equipment. After all, we understand that our product adds value to the quality of output of your equipment.
Beyond the one-year warranty on our product and spares, we offer a lifetime support maintenance program towards our ecosystem. This is primarily to ensure timely replacement of elements and spares provides maximum availability of your equipment at minimal operating costs - contributing to value as projected.
Our service network is constantly upgraded so in the case of any eventuality, response times can be minimized to keep your production schedules on time. Each of faults are logged in our internal complaint tracker and we have constantly used our data logs to further enhance the operational efficiency and lifespan of our products.
Service Assurance
Sustained Performance Support Services
We offer regular maintenance checks, which help in identifying problems early and preventing costly down times. Service engineers will periodically check your systems and optimize them for energy efficiency.
01
Installation and Commissioning
The equipment is handed over to the customer once the product is successfully commissioned. SANPAR believes that the commissioning is complete only when the end user is proficient in the maintenance of the equipment.
02
Preventive Maintenance Plan
Service agreements are available at the time of equipment purchase to provide priority scheduling and cost control by our trained engineers. A service warranty is maintained with service reports to keep track of individual system lifeline. Envisaging an upcoming problem by qualified team ensures minimal downtime.
03
Maintenance and ASC’s
As a standard, SANPAR offers an Annual Service Contract (ASC) with a Service Engineer visiting the customer’s site bi-monthly / quarterly during a contract year. Fixed service prices can avoid any economical or financial surprises. A total responsibility plan is an ultimate risk coverage with being eligible for upgrades and original spare replacements.
04
Spare Parts
For trouble free operation of the system, a stock of certain spares has to be maintained. Most of the spares will be dispatched within 48 hours, however some spares will be dispatched subject to their availability with our suppliers. Acquiring original, certified and compliant spares can maintain the lifetime of the equipment and overall system efficiency in output. Only genuine parts can guarantee the performance and integrity of the capital equipment.
05
Trouble Shooting
The training given by SANPAR to all its service engineers, coupled with their comprehensive knowledge on Compressed Air Technology and Refrigeration Concepts, results in excellent trouble shooting capability by our service team. In our experience, most issues are solved by giving tips to the customer via the telephone, once again reinforcing our belief in our products and solutions. We also cater to top priority emergency response to SOS calls for assistance by our nearest service centre.

headings.text: Applications of Advanced cooling systems in Aerospace in defence
Advanced cooling systems for Aerospace and Defence

paragraphs: Sanpar

Our advanced liquid cooling systems are designed with efficiency in mind.SANPAR systems are designed to be compact to handle the demands of modern avionics system.Our product portfolio includes a variety of products like Liquid Cooling System(LCS), Forced air chillers, Cold plates, Ground filling unit, Coolant Circulation module(CCM) and All in one (AIO) simulator and many more.Over the past decade, the evolution of advanced liquid cooling system technology has been significant to regulate temperature and ensure the reliability of critical components. SANPAR emerging engineers are allowed to simulate the flow of liquids and gases through complex systems, which helps them to optimize the design of cooling systems for maximum efficiency.

We strive to be at the forefront of innovation in the avionics & defence industry by continually improving and refining our advanced cooling systems to ensure that they are the most efficient, reliable, and cost-effective solutions.

An advanced liquid cooling system is a technology that uses a liquid to transfer heat away from a component or system, and is designed to provide superior cooling performance compared to traditional air-cooling methods. It typically involves the circulation of a coolant liquid through a system of channels or pipes, which absorb heat from the components being cooled, and then transport the heat to a radiator or other heat exchanger, where it is dissipated into the environment.

A coolant circulation module (CCM) is a component of a liquid cooling system that is responsible for circulating coolant fluid throughout the system to regulate temperature and ensure efficient cooling. The CCM typically consists of a pump, a reservoir, and a set of valves and sensors that control the flow and temperature of the coolant.

The pump is responsible for moving the coolant fluid through the system, while the reservoir stores excess coolant and helps maintain the correct fluid level. The valves and sensors are used to control the flow and temperature of the coolant. Coolant circulation modules are a critical component of liquid cooling systems.

Our compressed air Dryers & Chillers plays a critical role in the machine tools industry. SANPAR Air dryers ensure clean dry air which is used to remove moisture and contaminents from compressed air systems that power various pneumatic tools and equipment’s. Our Air dryers ensure Improved equipment performance, Reduced maintenance costs, Increased energy efficiency, Improved air quality and enhanced worker safety. SANPAR Chillers in machine tool industries are used to regulate the temperature of cutting and grinding fluids, hydraulic oil, and spindle bearings in machine tools such as milling machines, lathes, grinders, and more. We deliver chillers for Increased tool life, Improved accuracy, Enhanced productivity and Reduced maintenance costs.

A compressed air dryer is a device used to remove moisture and other contaminants from compressed air systems. When air is compressed, the temperature increases, causing water vapor to condense and collect in the compressed air system. This moisture can cause corrosion, reduce the lifespan of pneumatic equipment, and compromise the quality of the compressed air supply. A compressed air dryer works by lowering the dew point of the compressed air, which causes the moisture to condense and be removed from the system.

Dry compressed air is used in the operation of machine tools to power pneumatic equipment, such as valves, actuators, Automatic tool changer (ATC), Pneumatic doors, Pneumatic clamping and declamping and in motors. However, compressed air can contain contaminants such as water vapor, oil, and particulates, which can damage the pneumatic equipment and negatively impact the quality of the finished products.

Chillers for the machine tool industry are cooling systems used to regulate the temperature of cutting tools and workpieces during the machining process. Machine tools generate a lot of heat due to the high speed and friction generated during the machining process. This heat can cause thermal expansion and distortion of the workpiece, which can lead to inaccuracies and poor quality finished products. Additionally, high temperatures can also damage the cutting tool, leading to premature wear and breakage.

A chiller for the machine tool industry works by circulating a coolant through the machine’s spindle, cutting tool, and workpiece. The coolant absorbs the heat generated during the machining process and carries it away, which helps to maintain a stable and consistent temperature in the machine. This ensures that the workpiece remains within its tolerance limits, resulting in high-quality finished products.

Cleanroom air supply- Dry compressed air that is supplied to cleanrooms to maintain low humidity levels.

Instrument air supply-Many instruments in the pharmaceutical industry require dry air to operate properly. Desiccant air dryers are used to dry the compressed air that is supplied to these instruments.
Product packaging-For blowing and vacuum seal pharmaceutical products. This helps prevent moisture from entering the packaging and affecting the quality of the product.
Product storage-Desiccant air dryers are used to dry the compressed air that is used in the storage of pharmaceutical products. This helps prevent moisture.
Compressed air systems- - Coalescing filters remove oil, water, and other contaminants from the compressed air.

Laboratory gas systems-- Laboratories often use specialty gases such as nitrogen, helium, and argon for research and analysis. Coalescing filters remove contaminants from these gases, which can affect the accuracy of experimental results.

Bioreactors and fermentation systems-Bioreactors and fermentation systems are used in the production of vaccines, antibiotics, and other pharmaceutical products. Coalescing filters remove contaminants from the air supply to these systems, which can affect the growth and purity of the microbial cultures.
Liquid filtration systems-Coalescing filters are also used in liquid filtration systems, where they remove emulsified oil and other contaminants from process water and wastewater streams.

Cleanroom air conditioning- Precision air conditioners provide precise temperature and humidity control to ensure that the cleanroom remains within the required temperature and humidity ranges for maintaining the sterile environment.

Laboratory air conditioning-Precision air conditioners maintain a stable environment within the laboratory to ensure that equipment and samples are not affected by temperature and humidity fluctuations.

Server room air conditioning-Pharmaceutical companies rely heavily on data processing and storage, and precision air conditioners are used to maintain the temperature and humidity levels required for optimal server performance and longevity.

Storage facility air conditioning-Pharmaceutical companies rely heavily on data processing and storage, and precision air conditioners are used to maintain the temperature and humidity levels required for optimal server performance and longevity.
Packaging and manufacturing facilities-: Precision air conditioners ensures that the pharmaceutical products are manufactured and packaged under the correct conditions

Nitrogen generators- : used in packaging, dispensing, and purging. Nitrogen generators produce nitrogen gas on-site, eliminating the need for expensive and hazardous nitrogen gas cylinders. It also provides a consistent and reliable source of nitrogen gas, ensuring that pharmaceutical processes are not affected by fluctuations in the gas supply.

Oxygen generators-: Oxygen gas is used in the pharmaceutical industry for a variety of applications, including fermentation, cell culture, and purification. Oxygen generators produce oxygen gas on-site, eliminating the need for expensive and hazardous oxygen gas cylinders.

Blanketing and purging-Both nitrogen and oxygen generators can be used for blanketing and purging applications, where the gas is used to create an inert environment or remove oxygen from a process to prevent oxidation or degradation of pharmaceutical products.

Analytical instruments-Nitrogen gas is used as a carrier gas in gas chromatography (GC) and mass spectrometry (MS) analytical instruments, while oxygen gas is used as a combustion gas for some analytical instruments. Nitrogen and oxygen generators provide a cost-effective and reliable source of these gases, ensuring that analytical instruments operate accurately and consistently

Cryopreservation-Nitrogen gas is used in cryopreservation processes, where samples and cells are frozen and stored at ultra-low temperatures. Nitrogen generators provide a consistent and reliable source of nitrogen gas, which is used to maintain the temperature and pressure in cryopreservation systems.

Drying equipment- Some pharmaceutical processes require the removal of moisture from materials, such as granulation, tablet compression, and capsule filling. Dehumidifiers are used to provide the required dry air for these processes, ensuring that the materials are not affected by excess moisture, which can impact their quality and stability.

Moisture-sensitive manufacturing processes:Any pharmaceutical manufacturing process where it is sensitive to high humidity levels, which can impact their performance and quality. Dehumidifiers are used to remove excess moisture from the air in these processes to ensure that the required humidity levels are maintained.

Drying of Raw Materials-Raw materials such as limestone, clay, and shale need to be dried before they can be used in the cement production process. This is typically achieved using rotary dryers, which are large cylindrical vessels that rotate while hot air is blown through them. The hot air dries the raw materials, reducing their moisture content to a suitable level for processing.

Drying of Finished Cement-After the cement is produced, it is typically dried to remove excess moisture before it is stored or transported. This is usually done using a vertical roller mill (VRM), which uses hot gases to dry the cement as it is ground.

Dust Collection-Cement production generates a lot of dust, which can be harmful to workers and the environment. Dust collectors, such as bag filters or electrostatic precipitators (ESPs), are used to capture and remove this dust from the air.

Gas Conditioning-Before it can be used in the production process, the hot gases generated by the kiln must be cooled and cleaned. This is typically done using a gas conditioning tower, which cools the gases and removes any excess moisture or particulate matter.

Clinker Cooling-After the clinker is produced in the kiln, it needs to be cooled before it can be ground into cement. This is usually achieved using a grate cooler, which uses a stream of air to cool the clinker as it passes through a series of grates.

Steam-Steam is used extensively in the textile industry for processes like dyeing, finishing, and shrinkage control. Steam is generated using boilers and then distributed throughout the plant using pipes. The temperature and pressure of the steam can be controlled to suit the specific process requirements.

Hot Airs-Hot air is used for processes like heat setting, drying, and curing. Hot air is generated using heaters and then distributed throughout the plant using ducts. The temperature and airflow rate can be controlled to suit the specific process requirements.

Infrared Radiation- Infrared radiation is used for processes like drying and curing. Infrared lamps generate heat that is absorbed by the textile material, leading to faster drying times and improved curing.

Thermosol Dyeing-Thermosol dyeing is a process that uses a combination of heat and chemicals to dye synthetic fibers. The fibers are heated to a high temperature, which causes the dye to bond with the fibers. This process is used for dyeing polyester, nylon, and other synthetic fibers.

Thermofixation-Thermofixation is a process that uses heat to set the dye and improve the color fastness of the textile material. The textile material is heated to a high temperature for a specific period of time, which allows the dye to fully penetrate and bond with the fibers.

Textile machinery- Compressed air is used to operate looms, spinning machines, and sewing machines. Moisture in the compressed air can cause damage to these machines and affect their performance, so compressed air dryers are used to remove the moisture and ensure the machines are running smoothly.
Air tools-Textile manufacturers use compressed air-powered tools for tasks like cutting, stapling, and packaging.

Cleaning-Compressed air is used for cleaning fabrics, equipment, and workspaces in textile manufacturing facilities. Compressed air dryers are used to ensure that the air used for cleaning is dry and free of moisture.
Air jet Weaving- Air jet weaving is a textile manufacturing process that involves using high-pressure air jets to insert weft yarns into a warp shed in which compressed air dryer is used.

-Thermosol dyeing is a process that uses a combination of heat and chemicals to dye synthetic fibers. The fibers are heated to a high temperature, which causes the dye to bond with the fibers. This process is used for dyeing polyester, nylon, and other synthetic fibers.
Thermofixation
-Thermofixation is a process that uses heat to set the dye and improve the color fastness of the textile material. The textile material is heated to a high temperature for a specific period of time, which allows the dye to fully penetrate and bond with the fibers.
Application of our products in Textile Industry
Textile machinery
- Compressed air is used to operate looms, spinning machines, and sewing machines. Moisture in the compressed air can cause damage to these machines and affect their performance, so compressed air dryers are used to remove the moisture and ensure the machines are running smoothly.
Air tools
-Textile manufacturers use compressed air-powered tools for tasks like cutting, stapling, and packaging.
Cleaning
-Compressed air is used for cleaning fabrics, equipment, and workspaces in textile manufacturing facilities. Compressed air dryers are used to ensure that the air used for cleaning is dry and free of moisture.
Air jet Weaving
- Air jet weaving is a textile manufacturing process that involves using high-pressure air jets to insert weft yarns into a warp shed in which compressed air dryer is used.

SANPAR Compressed air dryers, such as refrigerated dryers and desiccant dryers, are often used to remove moisture and other contaminants from the compressed air, ensuring that the compressed air used in the food and beverage industry is clean and free from contaminants, which can help to improve the quality and safety of food products. Beverages, such as beer, wine, and soft drinks, are sensitive to moisture, and even small amounts of moisture can affect their taste, aroma, and shelf life. Moisture can also promote the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms, leading to spoilage and potential health hazards.

The presence of moisture in the food industry can pose significant risks to product quality, safety, and shelf life. Moisture can come from various sources, such as the ingredients, the environment, or the production process itself. Regardless of the source, excess moisture can create an environment that is conducive to the growth of bacteria, mold, and other microorganisms. These microorganisms can cause spoilage, degradation of product quality, and even pose health risks to consumers. Moisture can also contribute to the corrosion of equipment used in the food industry.

Commodity plastics- Commodity plastics also known as standard plastics, are widely used in everyday products such as packaging, toys, and household items. These plastics are relatively inexpensive, easy to process, and have good chemical resistance. Some examples of commodity plastics include polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polystyrene (PS), and polyvinyl chloride (PVC).

Engineering plastics-On the other hand, are higher-performance plastics that are designed for specific applications where high strength, temperature resistance, and chemical resistance are required. These plastics are more expensive than commodity plastics and are used in applications such as automotive parts, electrical and electronic components, and medical devices. Some examples of engineering plastics include acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS), polycarbonate (PC), polyamide (PA), and polyethylene terephthalate (PET).

headings.text: Applications of our products in chemical industry
Applications of our products in Chemical Industry

paragraphs: Sanpar

The chemical industry is a vast and complex sector that plays a critical role in the global economy. It involves the production of a wide range of chemicals, including petrochemicals, polymers, and specialty chemicals, which are used in various products and applications across many industries, including automotive, construction, electronics, and pharmaceuticals.
Dry compressed air is commonly used in the chemical industry for various applications where moisture can have a negative impact on the chemical processes and change its properties.

SANPAR have a wide range of products portfolio such as Xeros Dryers, Eco dryers, Chillers, Filters, Oxygen Generator, Nitrogen Generator, coalescing filters and many more that facilitate various processes and applications in chemical industry.

Shelf life of a chemical refers to the period of time during which the chemical remains stable and effective when stored under appropriate conditions. It is the time from the date of manufacture until the product becomes unsuitable for its intended use due to changes in its physical or chemical properties.

The management of chemical shelf life involves ensuring that chemicals are stored under the appropriate conditions and that their usage is within the recommended timeframe. This includes proper labelling and documentation of chemical inventory, appropriate storage conditions (such as temperature and humidity), regular inspection and testing of chemicals, and appropriate disposal of expired chemicals.

We are Sanpar
The chemical industry is a vast and complex sector that plays a critical role in the global economy. It involves the production of a wide range of chemicals, including petrochemicals, polymers, and specialty chemicals, which are used in various products and applications across many industries, including automotive, construction, electronics, and pharmaceuticals.
Dry compressed air is commonly used in the chemical industry for various applications where moisture can have a negative impact on the chemical processes and change its properties.
SANPAR have a wide range of products portfolio such as Xeros Dryers, Eco dryers, Chillers, Filters, Oxygen Generator, Nitrogen Generator, coalescing filters and many more that facilitate various processes and applications in chemical industry.
What is Shelf life?
Shelf life of a chemical refers to the period of time during which the chemical remains stable and effective when stored under appropriate conditions. It is the time from the date of manufacture until the product becomes unsuitable for its intended use due to changes in its physical or chemical properties.
What is Shelf life Management?
The management of chemical shelf life involves ensuring that chemicals are stored under the appropriate conditions and that their usage is within the recommended timeframe. This includes proper labelling and documentation of chemical inventory, appropriate storage conditions (such as temperature and humidity), regular inspection and testing of chemicals, and appropriate disposal of expired chemicals.

Gas separation & Gas Generation
-Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA), Nitrogen Generation, Oxygen Generation, Hydrogen Generation, Gas Storage.
Drying and dehydration
-Processing air and gas streams, Spray Drying to atomize liquid feedstock into small droplets, Freeze Drying to remove moisture from the product in a vacuum chamber, Dehydration of Gases to prevent corrosion in pipelines and equipment, Drying of Solvents to prevent moisture from impacting the quality of the solvent.
Cooling
-Air-Cooled Heat Exchangers, Refrigeration, Injection Molding
Blown Film Extrusion
-dry air helps to prevent the film from sticking or losing its shape due to excess moisture.

paragraphs: Sanpar
Today’s small and compact, multi-function electronic controls, variable speed drives, servos and programmable logic controllers (PLC) are extremely sensitive to heat and contamination.
Mobile
I Agree to thePrivacy Policy

Smaller cabinet sizes make temperature control difficult and contribute to significant premature failures. Excessive heat causes components to cook, digital displays to misread, controls to drift, and breakers to trip below their rated loads. The result is often lost productivity from machine or line shutdown. And fans often provide inadequate cooling and commonly pull in dirty, humid air creating another source of failure.

Our Xerion series of dehumidifiers works in accordance with the condensation principal. A fan draws the humid air into the dehumidifier and through an evaporator coil. While passing through an evaporator the air is cooled down to below its dew point temperature, and its content of water vapour is condensed into water, which is collected in the drain tray. The cooled air is then further sensibly heated in order to reduce the Relative Humdity and carrying capacity of Air to reatin the Water.

headings.text: Integration of Control Mechanisms in Precision Air Conditioners
Efficient De-humidification with Hot Gas Re-Heat

paragraphs: Sanpar

The fine balance between temperature and relative humidity is intrinsically linked. By precisely controlling temperature, the SANPAR make Precision Air Conditioner accurately controls humidity. Its’ controlled advanced components work in seamless harmony, simultaneously balancing temperature and relative humidity.
SANPAR offers a PRECISION AIR CONDITIONER (CLIMATE CONTROLLER) with a capacity of maintaining a tolerance limit of +/- 1°C in temperature and +/- 2% in Relative Humidity.

For technology rooms, environmental control is more than simple cooling. Comfort cooling systems are designed to cool people and office spaces. They cannot provide the kind of environment required by high performance servers and telecom equipment. An adverse swing in temperature and/or humidity may result in complete system shutdown. This can create huge costs for the company, depending on the length of the interruption and the value of time and data lost. Standard building cooling systems are designed to keep people comfortable 8-12 hours each day, five days a week and only during the warmest months. Sensitive electronics must be maintained in a stable environment of 20 – 25°C temperature with a relative humidity of 40% to 55% all- round the year. The computers and electronic equipment generate large quantities of heat in small areas, nearly 6 to 10 times the heat density of normal office space, the air conditioning system must have more than just enough cooling capacity. It must have the precision to react quickly to a drastic change in heat load and prevent  wide temperature and humidity fluctuations. This feature aids the client to record and refer to the history of the dryer upon the health of the PAC upon every tripped event.

The SANPAR make Precision Air Conditioner segregates moisture from the air using one part cooling and varying the speed of the air so that optimum surface contact time is met between air and coil. When sensible heating is required during the cooling de-humidification mode, the Hot Gas Re- Heat offers an extremely energy-efficient methodology by providing Re-Heat capability by bypassing energy that would normally be rejected to the outside by the condenser. Hence thereby achieving considerable energy saving for the client.
The Control Centre for each of our cooling solutions incorporates a sophisticated electronic microprocessor with its control logic specifically developed by SANPAR Industries Pvt. Ltd.

The Microprocessor utilizes various sensors to send and receive detailed information to and from vital components such as Refrigerant Compressors, Fans, Pumps and Control Valves so they interact with each other in perfect unity to balance cooling duty, temperature, air flow, relative humidity and pressure to exactly match the client’s requirements. Our Microprocessor can also be fully-integrated with multiple units having the capabilities to work in tandem to fully optimise the climatic control based on the application. By integrating intelligent components, the microcontroller manages the system’s performance thus reducing the power draw drastically upon load.

Due to the use of Electronically Commutated variable speed fans, we have provided advanced power savings by fully integrating the fan control to the quality of air, thus also ensuring very low operating sound levels.
This facility enables the control frequency of opening of the two-Condensate drain valves. This process can either be set upon a timer or based on the level of the condensate.
This feature safeguards the compressor from frequently starting and stopping due to power failure from the incoming side. Hence ensuring longer life for the compressor.

This feature allows the client to automatically record and access a detailed history of the dryer’s performance and its impact on the health of the Precision Air Conditioner (PAC) during each tripping event. By maintaining a comprehensive event log, users can analyze past incidents, identify recurring issues, and make informed maintenance or operational decisions to enhance system reliability and efficiency.

SANPAR included this feature to enable the client to connect either one or multiple Air Chillers in tandem to monitor and control either through wired LAN connection or wirelessly. SANPAR will also be closely monitoring each connected dryer in our network to provide proactive maintenance in the event of an imminent service visit.

paragraphs: Sanpar

By definition, filters are supposed to remove unwanted particles- be it solid, liquid, aerosols, mist or gas. Sanpar industries pvt ltd is one of the leading organisations in india manufacturing “microfilters”. These filters are in use in multitudes of industries of various capacities across the indian terrain, justifying the usage they are intended to. Painting, instrumentation, pneumatics, textiles are some of the critical application that these filters have served the purpose with acknowledged aplomb.
Mobile
I Agree to thePrivacy Policy

The concept of “low flow: long life” has been the mantra for SANPAR rather than “high flow: short life” while designing and selecting its filter cartridges. The lunatic adherence to this concept is in accordance with the tagline of “energy conservation in compressed air treatment” of SANPAR. This philosophy has stood in good stead when it comes to customer delight and their retention.

The cylindrical filter elements are housed in aluminum pressure die-cast or carbon steel housings for higher air flows. They ensure ISO 8573.1 Class 1 compliance for dust and residual oil content. Filtered air exits through the outlet, while unwanted oil is drained through no-loss compressed air drains, available in float type, liquid level-controlled, or electronic timer-based solutions.
These filters are adequately equipped with differential pressure gauges and indicators to ensure that filter cartridges are replaced not too early ; not too late which saves energy.

Each filter is supplied with an automatic drain to drain off the unwanted oil at the bottom of the housing through a no loss of valuable compressed air drain, which could be float type or liquid level controlled type or electronic timer based drain.

This enables to have a visual inspection of the condensate accumulated at the bottom of the filter. This monitors the drain’s performance or to know when to drain-off, if in case the manual drain is fitted.

Adsorption Based Compressed Air Dryers
By
SANPAR
/
June 25, 2025
360° Rotatable
SANPAR has the expertise and proven track record to design and manufacture dryers to supply clean dry air using the techniques of Adsorption process. Adsorption Drying is a process which is very popular and tested from immemorial. It is a reversible process. Moisture is adsorbed during the drying cycle and desorbed during the regeneration cycle.
Hence there are two towers: while one in the process of drying, the other is on the regeneration mode.

SANPAR design team put in their experience to design to deliver suit- the individual- application dryers.
Low pressure drop and low purge loss Along with least power consumption is the hallmark of SANPAR Dryers.
The heart of the Adsorption dryers consists of Desiccants, Pressure vessels, Directional Valves and the control logic.
The desiccants deployed are Molecular sieves, Activated Alumina or Silica gel.
The dryers can be designed to deliver bone dry air up to the dryness of (-) 70 deg C
Adsorption dryers could be categorized in to additional categories:
Pressure Swing Adsorption / Heatless Dryers
Heat of Compression Dryers
Blower reactivated Air Dryers
No- purge- loss Adsorption Dryers
Adsorption dryers are tailor designed to meet the individual requirements:
The quality of dryness required for a particular application
The type of Air Compressors used – Lubricated or Non lubricated
The operating pressures
Operating temperatures

headings.text: Technical Specification are for the following standard conditions
Zero Air Loss - ½” BSP/ ¾” BSP

paragraphs: Sanpar

When condensate is not drained from a compressed air system it damages compressed air system components. drain valves remove condensate and thereby protect the components downstream to the compressed air treatment system.
A drain valve should be installed at each place in your compressed air system where condensate accumulates.
SANPAR makeINTERNAL DRAINis a no air loss drain. SANPAR make internal drain is float type drain with standard 1/2″ bsp connections. there is no-air loss drain.

An AUTOMATIC TIMER CONTROLLED DRAINconsists of a strainer with a solenoid valve (230v A/C). The drain valve opens based on the timings set in the drain. Also the time interval between the successive openings of the valve can be set. The drain has standard ½’’ BSP connections.
ThisMECHANICAL FLOAT DRAINis highly-effective and requires no Electrical Supply for its operation. Also ensuring Zero precious Compressed Air Loss

The SANPAR Level Sensor Drain which ensures there is no loss of compressed air while the condensed moisture/water is drained off the Dryer/Filter/Air Receiver. The solenoid valve closes while the condensed water level reaches the bottom sensor and valve opens while the level reaches the top sensor. There is always a small amount of water that remain in housing, preventing the compressed air draining it along with water. Drain housing are equipped with all of the features required to make this the most efficient and cost effective draining solutions for compressed air system. The drain comes with an aluminium die cast housing that can withstand a maximum working pressure of 16 bar(g).

paragraphs: When condensate is not drained from a compressed air system it damages compressed air system components. drain valves remove condensate and thereby protect the components downstream to the compressed air treatment system.
A drain valve should be installed at each place in your compressed air system where condensate accumulates.
SANPAR makeINTERNAL DRAINis a no air loss drain. SANPAR make internal drain is float type drain with standard 1/2″ bsp connections. there is no-air loss drain.

An AUTOMATIC TIMER CONTROLLED DRAINconsists of a strainer with a solenoid valve (230v A/C). The drain valve opens based on the timings set in the drain. Also the time interval between the successive openings of the valve can be set. The drain has standard ½’’ BSP connections.
ThisMECHANICAL FLOAT DRAINis highly-effective and requires no Electrical Supply for its operation. Also ensuring Zero precious Compressed Air Loss

The SANPAR Level Sensor Drain which ensures there is no loss of compressed air while the condensed moisture/water is drained off the Dryer/Filter/Air Receiver. The solenoid valve closes while the condensed water level reaches the bottom sensor and valve opens while the level reaches the top sensor. There is always a small amount of water that remain in housing, preventing the compressed air draining it along with water. Drain housing are equipped with all of the features required to make this the most efficient and cost effective draining solutions for compressed air system. The drain comes with an aluminium die cast housing that can withstand a maximum working pressure of 16 bar(g).

paragraphs: Sanpar

One of the classic product rangers from the house of SANPAR. Ecodrair series are those refrigerant compressed air dryers which employs tube-in tube design of air to air and evaporator in the dryer. The capacity ranges from 5 cfm to 180 cfm with operating pressures from 4 bar g to 16 bar g., wherein higher pressure ranges are also available up to 50 bar g.
Mobile
I Agree to thePrivacy Policy

The dryer is incorporated with hot gas bye pass valve which acts as modulating valve during the air flow fluctuations. The dryer is also incorporated with capillary tube to ensure consistent evaporating temperature irrespective of load fluctuations and ambient temperature variations.

The digital dew point indicator ensures high accuracy, while differential pressure indicators on filters help optimize filter element replacement. These compact dryers have a minimal footprint with rear inlet and outlet connections for easy installation. Designed for silent, reliable operation, they require minimal maintenance—only periodic condenser fin cleaning and zero-loss drain upkeep based on site dust conditions.

paragraphs: Sanpar
Refrigerated Air Dryer
Hindustan Motors, Calcutta
Automobile

As a result of implementation of all our suggestions, successful commissioning of the dryers at HM has been able to avoid the usage of at least 6 compressors there by saving at least 8.7 lakhs per month.

Hindustan Motors is the producer of the famous Ambassador car, widely used as a taxicab and as a government limousine. One of the original three car manufacturers in India, founded in 1942, it was a leader in car sales until the 1980s.

In 1997, SANPAR conducted a case study in Hindustan Motors, Calcutta. It was found that the plant was equipped with a centralized Desiccant Dryer. Desiccant Dryer works with at least 25% purge losses for the purpose of regeneration of the desiccant. Apart from this loss, SANPAR noticed air leakage in the pneumatic line.

SANPAR suggested Hindustan Motors to replace the desiccant Dryer by a refrigerated Dryer, which is an energy efficient equipment and has no such, purge losses. Also, suggested the customer to arrest all the leaks in the pneumatic lines.

story-excel-glass.meta_description: Excel Glass Excel Glass PRODUCT Refrigerated Air Dryer CUSTOMER Excel Glass, Allappuzha, Kerela INDUSTRY TYPE Process Industry Outcome The aluminum plate type heat exchanger facilitates for a minimum water carry over across the dryer, so the glass mould is free from any blowholes.Excel Glass is one of the premier soda lime glass container ware
paragraphs: Sanpar
Refrigerated Air Dryer
Excel Glass, Allappuzha, Kerela
Process Industry
The aluminum plate type heat exchanger facilitates for a minimum water carry over across the dryer, so the glass mould is free from any blowholes.

Excel Glass is one of the premier soda lime glass container ware manufacturing concerns in India and has its works nestled in the backwater lagoons of midtown Alleppey on N.H. 47, 55 KM South of Cochin in Kerala.

Excel Glass is a leading glass manufacturer in India. The compressed air is used for blow molding of glass. The air that goes into the mould should be pure, free from any moisture content and dust of course. This results in excellent quality of glass, glass with no blowholes or dust in the final product. Compressed air at higher flow-rate and relatively lower pressures of 3 bar (g) is what used for this application. The earlier mode of moisture removal was by Shell and Tube type dryer. A shell and tube type dryer results in a pressure drop of 0.2 bar across the dryer, this results in additional power losses. Apart from this, these types of dryers are prone to frequent refrigerant leaks and moisture carry over during operation.

SANPAR suggested Excel Glass to replace the shell and tube type Dryer by SANPAR make XEROS series Dryer. The XEROS series supplied to Excel has the following features. Compact Aluminum plate type heat exchangers with a pressure drop of 0.1 bar across the dryer. The dryer is equipped with a compact brazed plate type Condensor.
THE SANPAR MAKE REFRIGERATED DRYER EXECUTED TO M/S EXCEL GLASS IS THE LARGEST BY AN INDIAN MANUFACTURER.

Excel Glass is one of the premier soda lime glass container ware manufacturing concerns in India and has its works nestled in the backwater lagoons of midtown Alleppey on N.H. 47, 55 KM South of Cochin in Kerala.

Excel Glass is a leading glass manufacturer in India. The compressed air is used for blow molding of glass. The air that goes into the mould should be pure, free from any moisture content and dust of course. This results in excellent quality of glass, glass with no blowholes or dust in the final product. Compressed air at higher flow-rate and relatively lower pressures of 3 bar (g) is what used for this application. The earlier mode of moisture removal was by Shell and Tube type dryer. A shell and tube type dryer results in a pressure drop of 0.2 bar across the dryer, this results in additional power losses. Apart from this, these types of dryers are prone to frequent refrigerant leaks and moisture carry over during operation.

SANPAR suggested Excel Glass to replace the shell and tube type Dryer by SANPAR make XEROS series Dryer. The XEROS series supplied to Excel has the following features. Compact Aluminum plate type heat exchangers with a pressure drop of 0.1 bar across the dryer. The dryer is equipped with a compact brazed plate type Condensor.
THE SANPAR MAKE REFRIGERATED DRYER EXECUTED TO M/S EXCEL GLASS IS THE LARGEST BY AN INDIAN MANUFACTURER.

JMT Auto has placed a repeat order for the same Dehumidifier for
paragraphs: Sanpar
Refrigerated Dehumidifier
JMT Auto, Jamshedpur
Automobile

The relative humidity in the standard room is being maintained with in the tolerance range so that the CMM machine functions at its accurate best. JMT Auto has placed a repeat order for the same Dehumidifier for the same application for their Dharwad plant.

JMT Auto Ltd., formerly known as Jamshedpur Metal Treat (JMT), is one of the leading Auto component manufacturers in Eastern region. JMT’s quality products meet the fastest growing industries of the current era – the auto industry.

JMT Auto is a leading manufacturer of automobile components like Transmission Gears, Engine Gears, Gear Box Assembly, Carrier Assembly, Shafts, Rear Axle Shafts, Synchro Rings, Seal were Rings, Synchronizing Cone, Fly wheels, Drums, Housing Pipes, Spindles and Pins. All these components are to be manufactured with the at most precision. This demands JMT to use sophisticated manufacturing facilities. One of the standard rooms houses a precision CMM machine, this special machine requires humidity be maintained with in close tolerances of 40 to 60%. Any slight variation in the RH (humidity) will result in the inaccurate functioning of the machine.

SANPAR suggested a refrigerate Dehumidifier that maintains the desired humidity content in the standard room. SANPAR make refrigerated dehumidifier consists of the following features. The equipment is made fully automatic with a built-in hygrostat and can be set to the required humidity level.
Precision-engineered solutions in compressed air treatment and industrial cooling, trusted globally for over 31 years.

story-gas-turbine.meta_description: GAS TURBINE RESEARCH ESTABLISHMENT Gas Turbine Research Establishment, Bangalore PRODUCT High Pressure Compressed Air Treatment System CUSTOMER Gas Turbine Research Establishment, Bangalore INDUSTRY TYPE Research establishment Outcome As a result of implementation of suggestions from SANPAR, successful commissioning of the dryers GTRE has been able to bring down the power consumption for cooling air
paragraphs: Sanpar
High Pressure Compressed Air Treatment System
Gas Turbine Research Establishment, Bangalore
Research establishment
As a result of implementation of suggestions from SANPAR, successful commissioning of the dryers GTRE has been able to bring down the power consumption for cooling air considerably.
GTRE is a government establishment that is involved in research on space shuttle engines in Bangalore.

During the testing of the same, blades fitted on to the rotor of the engine, at maximum speed will expand due to high temperatures. An arrangement is made to monitor this dimensional change with respect to the temperature. The electronic set up that is used for monitoring this change that also heats up during the process. So it is imperative to cool this measuring device and the recommended coolant for the same is cool dry air at a high pressure of 35 bar g. Earlier the cooling was done by means of a Desiccant Dryer. Desiccant Dryer works with at least 25% purge losses for the purpose of regeneration of the desiccant resulting in power loss.

SANPAR suggested GTRE a refrigerated COMPRESSED AIR TREATMENT SYSTEM comprising of a refrigerated compressed air dryer and filters for the same applications with the following specification. The compressed air treatment includes refrigerated compressed air dryer, pre filter, after filter, final filter, timer drains, pressure regulators, flow meter and flow control valves entirely mounted on a mobile trolley. Capacity: 22 cfm. / Operating pressure: 35 bar g.
Precision-engineered solutions in compressed air treatment and industrial cooling, trusted globally for over 31 years.

Jindal Steel & Power Limited – Raigarh
Jindal Steel & Power Limited, Raighar
PRODUCT
Refrigerated Air Dryer
CUSTOMER
Jindal Steel & Power Limited, Raighar
INDUSTRY TYPE
Process industry
Outcome
The dry air serves a vital point of production, and protecting against frequent production downtime. The non-compromise on quality air at their critical process enabled them to maintain quality and market share with large production volumes.
Jindal Steel and Power Company Ltd., India’s largest integrated galvanising facilities in private sector accounting for 25% of total galvanising production in the country. Engaged in Hot Rolling, Cold Rolling and Galvanising business.
Requirement
Jindal Steel and Power Ltd, Raigarh. is a major manufacturer of carbon steel and stainless steel in India. The new production facility at Raigarh, was to be supplied with compressed air free from moisture for the blast furnace. SANPAR has suggested refrigerated type compressed air dryers of very large capacity and with varied operating pressures.
Solution
SANPAR has suggested refrigerated type compressed air dryers of very large capacity and with varied operating pressures.
SED 1600W (2 Nos.)
Capacity: 85 Nm3/min.
Pressure: 6 to 8 bar g.
SED 1000W (2 Nos.)
Capacity: 135 Nm3/min.
Pressure: 6 to 8 bar g.
SED 850W (2 Nos.)
Capacity: 66 Nm3/min.
Pressure: 10.50 to 14.50 bar g.
All the 6 systems are R407c refrigerant dryers; R407C is an eco friendly refrigerant.
SANPAR Service
Installation and Commissioning of the equipment at the customer’s site successfully.
Training to the customer regarding the operation and control logic of the system.
Prompt service attention.
